reason_for_choice: 1e-2 diverged early; 1e-4 converged too slowly within MAX_EPOCHS; 1e-3 gave stable loss decrease with Adam.
LR*0.1 let the fine-tune stage keep improving val_loss without destabilizing the pretrained weights.
32 balanced GPU memory usage and gradient noise; 16 was noisier, 64 gave marginal speed gain but worse val loss.
128 mel bands captured more spectral detail and improved val accuracy over 64; adopted as the current experiment config.
0.3 reduced the train/val loss gap versus 0.2 without the underfitting seen at 0.5.
1e-4 gave the best val performance; 1e-3 over-regularized and raised train loss.
1e-5 added mild sparsity pressure without measurably hurting accuracy.
5 epochs avoided stopping on short-term val_loss noise while still limiting overfitting time.
5-fold gave a stable bias/variance estimate without excessive extra training time.
30 was enough for early stopping to trigger in all runs observed; 50 rarely trained longer in practice.
